name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck ordering system
promotionalText: Take orders in advance, protect your kitchen from orders beyond its capacity and keep serving when the connection drops too. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can prepare, then mark the order ready and handed over.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T KEEP
Set how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a collection time fills up, customers can’t choose that time, so the queue fits your kitchen’s pace.

TAKE ORDERS ON THE SPOT
Add orders placed in front of the food truck to the same screen as orders placed in advance; let the kitchen work from a single queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to prepare now, what is next in line and what is ready, and warns you when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect the kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or your local network; order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE CONNECTION DROPS TOO
Switch on offline protection: if the connection drops, taking orders in advance pauses, so nobody can place an order you won’t be able to see. Orders you take on the device are kept and synced when you are online again.

DESIGNED FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on throughout service, get a notification when an order is waiting for confirmation, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations once, and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is for food truck operators and their staff. You must have a HatchGrab account to sign in.
